title: Detailed football
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='ballGrad' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='65%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#e8e8e8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b0b0b0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='shine' cx='35%' cy='30%' r='40%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Ball base -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='42' fill='url(#ballGrad)' stroke='#888888' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Center pentagon -->
  <polygon points='50,36 61,44 57,57 43,57 39,44'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Top pentagon -->
  <polygon points='50,12 60,18 57,29 43,29 40,18'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <polygon points='50,88 60,82 57,71 43,71 40,82'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <polygon points='17,34 27,28 34,36 30,48 18,46'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Right-top pentagon -->
  <polygon points='83,34 73,28 66,36 70,48 82,46'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Left-bottom pentagon -->
  <polygon points='17,66 27,72 34,64 30,52 18,54'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Right-bottom pentagon -->
  <polygon points='83,66 73,72 66,64 70,52 82,54'
           fill='#2a2a3a' stroke='#4a4a5a' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Connecting lines from center pentagon to outer pentagons -->
  <line x1='50' y1='36' x2='50' y2='29' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='64' x2='50' y2='71' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='39' y1='44' x2='34' y2='36' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>

  <line x1='61' y1='56' x2='66' y2='64' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>

  <!-- Outer edge lines -->
  <line x1='43' y1='29' x2='40' y2='18' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='29' x2='60' y2='18' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='43' y1='71' x2='40' y2='82' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='71' x2='60' y2='82' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='36' x2='27' y2='28' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='48' x2='18' y2='46' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='36' x2='73' y2='28' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='48' x2='82' y2='46' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='34' y1='64' x2='27' y2='72' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='30' y1='52' x2='18' y2='54' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='66' y1='64' x2='73' y2='72' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>
  <line x1='70' y1='52' x2='82' y2='54' stroke='#555565' stroke-width='1.8'/>

  <!-- Shine highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='16' ry='12' fill='url(#shine)' transform='rotate(-25 38 32)'/>

  <!-- Small extra shine -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='28' r='3' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.6'/>
